preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call enableTrading()

exploit_hint: The contract owner can control when trading is enabled for all users. Call enableTrading() function to set tradingEnabled from false to true. Before this call, all non-excluded users cannot transfer tokens (require(tradingEnabled, 'Trading is not enabled yet') in _transfer function). This gives the owner complete control over when the token becomes tradeable, potentially allowing them to manipulate market timing or prevent trading indefinitely.
